Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: The digestive system breaks food down into molecules that are used by our body's cells. Which other body system regulates how fast or slow the digestive system functions?
A. circulatory system
B. excretory system
C. immune system
D. nervous system
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
